function_revised: Conserved hypothetical protein with an X-ray crystal structure at 1.38 A: a 16.2 kDa monomer adopting a primarily alpha-helical fold with limited similarity to known structures (COG5579). Not a novel fold but a model for sequence-related orthologues. Function unknown. (The UniProt auto-name 'Calpastatin' is a database artefact and is not adopted.)
